extracted.name: Cilantro Lime Dressing
extracted.description: This easy cilantro lime dressing is great to have on hand in the fridge for topping onto salads, tacos, or burrito bowls. To make it creamy, add 1/2 avocado or Greek yogurt to the base recipe!
ingredient_lines: ½ cup whole milk Greek yogurt
instruction_lines: In a food processor, place the cilantro, garlic, lime juice, maple syrup, coriander, and salt and pulse to combine. With the blade running, pour in the olive oil and process until smooth.
Make it creamy (optional) - blend with 1 avocado or ½ cup plain whole milk Greek yogurt
